problem: Production water previously used an approximate sky color because no rendered scene texture was supplied. Reflected terrain/objects were missing.
result: Production planar RGBA8/depth-stencil scene target now supplies terrain and native objects to the existing source-derived two-normal water distortion path. Above-water terrain/model clipping prevents submerged geometry from contaminating the target. Main and reflected seasonal skins use the same actual saved simulation tick.

api.callback: drawScene({vp,eye,clipPlane:[0,1,0,-waterHeight],capture:true,width,height}); synchronous terrain/model-only callback, no water recursion or sampling this target.
api.terrainHook: drawTerrain({...,clipPlane:null,capture:false}); main default resets the clip uniform. capture:true preserves main terrain counters.
api.modelHook: draw({...,clipPlane:null,capture:false}); Materials renderer owns this hook and preserves picking/timer/main metrics during capture.
api.lifecycle: Reuses same-size attachments, proportionally resizes within limits, retires still-bound previous targets, disposes resources, rejects recursive/async draws. Exceptions and incomplete allocation restore caller state.
